findings.title: Clinic baseCosts cost and fee values render as HTML in Admin Settings
findings.attacker: Firestore isSuper() principal who can write settings/clinicConfig (receptionist via SDK/console bypassing SettingsManager.isAdmin UI gate; admins via UI).
findings.attack_path: Write baseCosts.diana.cost to ">. Admin opens Panel de Configuración → Costos y Comisiones. _renderCosts builds value="${data.cost}" / value="${data.fee}" into innerHTML with no escaping.
findings.impact: Stored XSS in the admin settings session (CSP allows unsafe-inline); theft of Firebase/Google tokens from localStorage and actions as the admin.
findings.evidence: AdminSettingsModal.js _renderCosts ~289-305 interpolates data.cost/data.fee into attribute values inside container.innerHTML. firestore.rules settings write: isSuper().
findings.why_not_duplicate: 2026-08-01 theme-catalog finding covers themes[].name/subthemes/items/theme.id onclick and PatientModals theme UIs, not the Costs tab baseCosts.*.cost|fee sinks.

findings.title: AuditPanel activity rows render userName as HTML
findings.attacker: Firestore isSuper() principal (receptionist/admin) who can create documents in audit_logs under the default isSuper write rule.
findings.attack_path: addDoc audit_logs with userName containing HTML. Admin/reception opens Bitácora. createLogCard inserts ${log.userName} into innerHTML without escapeHTML.
findings.impact: Stored XSS in the audit UI used by admin/reception; session/token theft.
findings.evidence: AuditPanel.js ~175 interpolates log.userName unescaped. audit_logs matched by default rule allow read,write if isSuper() with no field validation.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Prior AuditPanel findings cover details.patientName, details.therapist, and WhatsApp details.message/cancel notes — not userName.

findings.title: Multi-therapist calendar chips render raw appointments.therapist as HTML
findings.attacker: Authenticated therapist who can update an appointment they currently own under isOwner(resource.data.therapist) on the pre-update document.
findings.attack_path: Update owned appointment therapist to <img...>. Firestore checks ownership on existing therapist only. isSuper calendar 'Todas' view loads the doc; isViewAll chip path builds therapistName from tKey and interpolates it into chip.innerHTML without escape.
findings.impact: Stored therapist-to-admin/reception XSS on the main calendar; token theft / actions as privileged staff.
findings.evidence: CalendarUI.js ~235-288 isViewAll chip innerHTML uses therapistName derived from evt.therapist with no escapeHTML.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Prior CalendarUI items are appointment names and cancelledBy. Therapist-key XSS was flagged in Sidebar/Financial/Corte/Audit/PatientModals — not this CalendarUI all-view chip builder. Distinct from Firestore move-records privilege finding.

findings.title: Appointment justification Ver button opens attacker-controlled URLs
findings.attacker: Authenticated therapist who can update an owned cancelled appointment.
findings.attack_path: Set justificationUrl to https://evil.example/phish or data:text/html,... Victim staff opens cancelled appointment modal and clicks Ver. Handler is window.open(ev.justificationUrl, '_blank') with no Storage URL allowlist.
findings.impact: Open redirect / phishing from a trusted clinic UI control; credential harvesting against staff.
findings.evidence: CalendarModal.js ~393-398 and ~640 bind viewJustificationBtn.onclick to window.open(ev.justificationUrl) without scheme/host checks.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Prior PatientModals finding is HTML attribute breakout inside inline onclick=window.open('${url}'). This is a programmatic window.open in CalendarModal (redirect/phishing vs attribute XSS).
